count.asset_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 资产总数 FROM aisec.ai_assets;
count.vuln_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 漏洞总数 FROM aisec.ai_vuln;
count.fwq: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 服务器总数 FROM aisec.ai_assets WHERE assets_type = '服务器';
count.aqsb: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 安全设备总数 FROM aisec.ai_assets WHERE assets_type = '安全设备';
count.yyxt: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 应用系统总数 FROM aisec.ai_assets WHERE assets_type = '应用系统';
count.zdsb: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端设备总数 FROM aisec.ai_assets WHERE assets_type = '终端设备';
count.wlsb: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 网络设备总数 FROM aisec.ai_assets WHERE assets_type = '网络设备';

table.asset_vuln_count_table:
SELECT 
    a.assets_type AS 资产类型,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS 资产数量,
    COUNT(v.id) AS 漏洞数量,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vuln_level = '高危' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 高危数量,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vuln_level = '中危' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 中危数量,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vuln_level = '低危' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 低危数量
FROM 
    aisec.ai_assets a
LEFT JOIN 
    aisec.ai_vuln v ON a.id = v.assets_id
GROUP BY 
    a.assets_type;
table.vuln_table:
SELECT 
    IFNULL(am.vendor, '未知供应商') AS 供应商名称,
    a.assets_name AS 资产名称,
    v.vuln_name AS 漏洞名称,
    v.vuln_level AS 危险等级,
    v.create_time AS 发现时间,
    v.vuln_status AS 状态
FROM 
    aisec.ai_assets a
LEFT JOIN 
    aisec.ai_assets_manage am ON a.id = am.assets_id
JOIN 
    aisec.ai_vuln v ON a.id = v.assets_id
WHERE 
    v.vuln_status = '待修复'
    AND v.vuln_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN am.vendor IS NOT NULL AND am.vendor != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    am.vendor, 
    a.assets_name;
